text_block_list.text:
Oh... Is this not the day of Saint
Valentine?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Were you aware, Тренер? I have been wanting to play the part of that saint, just once.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day, and T.M.
Opera O hits
the ground running... It's
something I'm quite used
to already.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, Happy Valentine's
Day,
Trainer! I present you with...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Der Freischütz chocolate magic bullets
from the
Opera Chocolate Series!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Within this box are seven small pieces of

bullet-shaped chocolate, six of which
carry luck.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The last carries misfortune! Eat it and all
hell will
break loose—on your palate!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Why? Isn't it obvious? Love burns
brightest
against adversity.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Overcoming this difficult trial will surely

strengthen your love for me!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I don't see how this could be enjoyable,
but I
can't imagine there's much use in
arguing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, let us begin the Der Freischütz
chocolate
tasting extraordinaire!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, choose whichever chocolate you
wish and
bite into it with all your spirit!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
There's no stopping now. I muster up my
courage,
pop one in my mouth, and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: W-well?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Fortune has smiled upon you! You
drew a
lucky one right off the bat!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And? How does my homemade
chocolate taste?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oho! But of course it does! That's
precisely why I
went through the trouble
of making them myself.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: What a relief. Ahaha... Haha...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: But I tire of this, Trainer! I am bored!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We cannot end the play without a
climactic
scene!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
So, help yourself to a second. Go on,
have
another.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
At this rate, she might have me eating
until I take
the misfortune chocolate, so
I try to protest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmph, very well. I have a proposition,
then. We
each have one in turns.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Whoever eats the misfortunate
chocolate loses.
Do we have an accord?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Opera O and I go back and forth eating
the
chocolates.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Munch, chew, chew...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ah, yet another lucky chocolate for me!
Heh...
This tension is enthralling. Your
turn now.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Hm? Have you something to say?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
These are Russian roulette chocolates, aren't
they?

text_block_list.text:
Russian roulette? I already told you,
these are
chocolate magic bullets from
Der Freischütz.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Ehh heh heh heh...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Bwaa ha ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Chocolate magic bullets!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, let us continue our undeniable
game of
chocolate magic bullets!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: W-well?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Thud!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Daaah! Тренер? TRAAAINER!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I wake up in the infirmary with a
stomachache.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Regained consciousness, have you,
Тренер? I'm
glad to see you escaped the
grips of death.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Very glad... If anything were to become
of you,
I...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, please rest. I shan't leave your
side until
you are right as rain.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock, knock!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Opera O! Please, come out, Opera O!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Pleeease! I'm lost without you!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: My word, they are loud.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Fans eagerly awaiting my presence.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I canceled all of my events after you
took ill.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: Are you sure that was a good idea?

text_block_list.text:
But of course. There is nothing in
existence more
important to me than
you.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now, let your heart sing out with love
within our
private oasis in the midst of
this cacophony. Lala,
lalaaa! ♪
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
How much of that is true, I'm not sure.
Even so,
it's easy to see she's worried
about me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That was quite a Valentine's Day. But
through it,
I've come to understand her
feelings.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! I just recalled that I brought a
get-well
present for you.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Feast on this and recover your strength.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Second in the Opera Chocolate Series,
the
Deluded Bridegroom!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I refuse with every ounce of my being.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems she's not going to give on the
name. The
both of us eat three pieces
each.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
